description: An awakened Ancient is not to be trifled with, even if she bears the vessel of a young girl.Once, the Morokai and the Deva were one. Known as the Ancients, they were possessed of incredible power, but the first apocalypse sundered their souls in twain. Long had the powerful Morokai overlord Azurai sought a means to seize this power for himself through the Ritual of Awakening, but it would first require the blood of an awakened Ancient. Thus did he set his sights on young Ezra, born of Morokai and Deva blood. With the assistance of High Inquisitor Aranvis, a trap was laid and sprung, and Ezra fell within their dark grasp.The Rih'alnase, free-spirited Morokai warriors under the banner of their chieftain Avani, tore a bloody path of rescue toward their young charge alongside her adoptive uncle, the Deva librarian Allanon. By the skin of their teeth and nearly at the cost of Allanon's life, the dark ritual was reversed, but a glimpse of the half-awakened Ancient within Ezra was a nightmare for the ages.Had the intrepid band failed in their mission, Ezra would have most certainly lost her mind from the influx of uncontrollable power. The awakened Ancient would have then gone on to wreak havoc across all of Eneroth, leaving naught but a trail of destruction in her wake, and not even the famed overlord Azurai could hope to stop her. All that would remain of their war-torn world would be ash and blood. For their sakes, and perhaps especially for that of the Rih'alnase and Allanon, it was just as well such a fate had not come to pass. Yet such possibilities still resurface in the dark depths of one's mind while walking the straits of traumatic memory...
